pages.text: In the morning, Mom did the milking. Milk pails stood side by side in the yard.
The milk had to reach the kitchen to make butter. Pipo hugged the first pail with both arms. He would not spill a drop.
Mr. Horse pulled up with a cart. "That will take all day! One trip with a cart."
He loaded the milk pails quickly. "Now, off we go!"
The cart bounced and rattled on the pebble path. Milk sloshed to and fro.
Splash! Milk spilled over, turning the cart white.
Milk dripped from Mr. Horse's mane too. A cat followed close behind the cart.
Pipo held just one remaining pail firmly. He walked softly and slowly.
One pail, then another. They lined up neatly at the kitchen door.
Even the last pail arrived without a spilled drop. Mom brought out the butter churn. At the well, Mr. Horse was washing his mane.
